en.name: Xanthelasma Removal (Plasma Arc)
en.meta_title: Xanthelasma Removal with Plasma Arc: Non-Surgical Treatment
en.meta_description: Safely and effectively remove xanthelasma (yellow cholesterol deposits on eyelids) with our non-surgical Plasma Arc treatment. This precise method removes the plaques without incisions, stitches, or significant downtime.
en.meta_keywords: xanthelasma removal, xanthelasma treatment, plasma arc, eyelid cholesterol deposits, non-surgical lesion removal

what_is.heading: What is Xanthelasma?
paragraphs: Xanthelasma are yellowish, flat plaques of cholesterol deposits that appear on or around the eyelids. While they are medically harmless, they can be a cosmetic concern. Our non-surgical Plasma Arc treatment offers a safe, precise, and highly effective method for removing them without incisions or stitches.

how_it_works.heading: How Plasma Arc Removal Works
paragraphs: The Plasma Arc device uses plasma energy to sublimate the targeted tissue layer by layer. This allows our practitioners to meticulously remove the xanthelasma deposits without damaging the surrounding healthy skin of the delicate eyelid area.

benefits.heading: A Superior, Non-Surgical Alternative
paragraphs: This procedure is a superior alternative to traditional surgical excision, which can leave scars. The treatment is performed with a topical anesthetic and has minimal downtime. Following the procedure, small carbon crusts form over the treated area, which fall off within a week to reveal new, clear skin. This advanced method results in excellent cosmetic outcomes.
